name: Pattern Strike
body:
When you let the patterns guide your aim, the effects are devastating.

Prerequisite(s): Oc’cli; pattern recognition ability.

Benefit(s): When you use pattern recognition ability to gain bonus to attack roll, the same bonus applies to the damage roll of that attack.
